rule.title: Fixture checkout rule
rule.text: Discount eligible items by 10%, then apply one £5 voucher if their discounted subtotal reaches £100. Add full-price items unchanged.
rule.domain: Prepared fixture baskets only; all amounts in the structured data are integer pence.

baseline.label: Scripted baseline: three ordinary baskets, two versions

a.title: Rework discounts and vouchers
a.diff:
FIXTURE PREVIEW: illustrative source description, not executable evidence.

ORIGINAL
Calculate the discounted eligible subtotal, check the voucher, add full-price items.

PROPOSED
Reorganise eligible subtotals, discount and voucher calculations.

Use the scripted baskets to review the interface; no code is executed.

cases.rationale: Fixture: 10% off £110.00 gives £99.00, below the £100.00 threshold. No £5.00 voucher applies.
Fixture: 10% off £200.00 gives £180.00. This meets the £100.00 threshold, so deduct the £5.00 voucher for £175.00.

followUp.rationale: Fixture: £120.00 discounts to £108.00. Deduct £5.00 and add the unchanged £50.00 for £153.00.

c.title: Calculate totals in one pass
c.diff:
FIXTURE PREVIEW: illustrative source description, not executable evidence.

ORIGINAL
Use separate passes over eligible and full-price items.

PROPOSED
Use a single loop to accumulate the two totals.

Use the scripted baskets to review the interface; no code is executed.

cases.rationale: Fixture: £80.00 discounts to £72.00, below the £100.00 threshold. Add the unchanged £30.00 for £102.00.
Fixture: £120.00 discounts to £108.00. The £5.00 voucher applies, leaving £103.00.

followUp.rationale: Fixture: all £120.00 is full-price, so neither the discount nor the £5.00 voucher applies.
